attributes.title: All duplicate Kafka processing events
attributes.description: nexus.idempotency.duplicate=true tag added platform-wide in Part 1 (saga-orchestrator, fraud-service, transaction-service, ledger-service, account-service, notification-service) - this is the query Zipkin's own basic search can't do: find every duplicate-consumption event across all services in one shot instead of checking each service's traces one at a time.

attributes.title: AI spans over 5s (any service, any model)
attributes.description: gen_ai.* tags confirmed live via Spring AI's built-in Observation convention (verified during Part 1 - see the chat gpt-4o-mini span with real gen_ai.request.model/gen_ai.usage.* tags in Zipkin). Filters on duration (Zipkin's span duration field, microseconds) combined with the gen_ai.system tag - exactly the AND-of-two-conditions search the prompt's cheatsheet asks for and Zipkin's own basic search UI can't express.

attributes.title: Error spans by error.type, last search window
attributes.description: ErrorTaggingObservationHandler (nexus-tracing-common, wired platform-wide) guarantees every failed span carries error.type - this combines that with a specific error.type value and error=true, another AND-of-two-conditions search.

attributes.title: Audit trail — SAR review required
attributes.description: requiresSarReview=true events from AuditEventDocument (nexus-audit-query-jvm) - the compliance-relevant subset of the audit trail, not the full firehose.

attributes.title: Audit trail — financial events by category
attributes.description: isFinancialEvent=true, all categories - the base view an audit-trail dashboard would build panels on top of.
